description: Six toggle flip-flops, each changing state on a rising edge at its input.

inputs.text: A rising edge here toggles that flip-flop; with nothing patched in, the flip-flop is toggled instead by the falling edge of the flip-flop before it, which chains them into a counter.

outputs.text: Carries the digital high voltage while that flip-flop is on and the low voltage while it is off.

menu: Randomize — turns each flip-flop on or off at random.
Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
